Reach out to begin

Quiet conversations that start change

If you’re considering therapy, you’ve taken a thoughtful first step. I offer focused, confidential sessions for adults navigating anxiety, relationship challenges, grief, burnout, and life transitions. Use the form to tell me what brought you here or choose a direct booking option.

Mode
Telehealth & in-person ({{CITY}}, {{STATE}})
Typical focus
Short- to medium-term work on patterns, coping, safety plans
License
{{LICENSE}}
{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Call: {{PHONE}}

Send a brief note

Or email: {{EMAIL}}

Common myths vs what actually helps

Myth: Therapy will fix me quickly.
Truth: Meaningful change typically unfolds over multiple sessions and requires practice between meetings.
Myth: You need to have everything figured out before starting.
Truth: Therapy is most useful when you are ready to explore uncertainty, not already healed.
Myth: Therapist tells you what to do.
Truth: I collaborate with you to surface patterns, skills, and decisions that fit your life.

Principles I bring to sessions

  • Curiosity-first listening that balances empathy with clarity
  • Skill-focused work: grounding, boundaries, communication
  • Practical experiments grounded in everyday life
Modalities: {{MODALITIES}}

Short case vignettes

Boundary setting & burnout
Worked with a mid-career professional to reduce workload, introduce recovery routines, and rehearse difficult workplace conversations over 14 sessions.
Anxiety & performance pressure
Short-term CBT-informed work to identify unhelpful thoughts, build exposure tasks, and strengthen self-compassion practices.

Practical questions

How do I book?
Use the Book link in the nav or the primary button above. You can also request a time via the form.
Insurance?
At this time I accept private pay and can provide a superbill for out-of-network reimbursement on request.
Cancellation?
Sessions canceled with less than 24 hours' notice may be billed. I’ll review policies during intake.

Quick contact

Phone: {{PHONE}}
Email: {{EMAIL}}
Location: {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}
Schedule a first visit

Questions people often ask

How many sessions will I need?
It depends on goals. Some people find 8–12 sessions useful for targeted work; others continue longer for deeper change. We can plan collaboratively.
What if I'm in crisis?
If you are in immediate danger, please call your local emergency number or a crisis line. Therapy is not an emergency service; I will discuss crisis plans and resources during intake.
Is what I say private?
Sessions are confidential within the limits of the law (e.g., imminent risk of harm, court orders). I will review confidentiality in our first session.
© {{THERAPIST_NAME}} • {{BUSINESS_NAME}} — {{LICENSE}}
Disclaimer: Therapy aims to support growth and symptom relief but does not guarantee specific outcomes. I do not provide emergency services. See the intake packet for scope and boundaries.
